sources.title: [2506.09353v3] DAVSP: Safety Alignment for Large Vision-Language Models ...
sources.snippet: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved impressive progress across various applications but remain vulnerable to malicious queries that exploit the visual modality. Existing alignment approaches typically fail to resist malicious queries while preserving utility on benign ones effectively.
